name: Mei
description: Therapist and wellness coach dedicated to helping others
fullBio: Mei is a compassionate therapist who dedicates her life to helping others heal. She has an uncanny ability to understand people and make them feel seen and valued. However, she struggles to prioritize her own needs and often sacrifices her happiness for others. She's afraid that if she's not helping someone, she has no value.
strengths: Brings out the best in people
idealMan: Someone who insists on taking care of her, who helps her understand that she deserves love too. Someone patient enough to break through her selfless barriers.
romanticArc: She's initially hesitant to accept your care, always deflecting back to you. But through your persistence and genuine affection, she learns that being loved is just as important as loving others.
